proposal.summary: Certain IBM TXSeries and CICS TX versions may transmit sensitive information in query parameters which could be intercepted via man-in-the-middle techniques.
proposal.affected_product: IBM TXSeries for Multiplatforms 8.1, 8.2, 9.1; CICS TX Standard 11.1; CICS TX Advanced 10.1, 11.1
proposal.cwe_quote: could transmit sensitive information in query parameters

AV.quote: could be intercepted using man in the middle techniques

C.quote: could transmit sensitive information in query parameters

proposal.recommended_next_step: Confirm which specific query parameters and endpoints expose sensitive data, determine whether transport protections (TLS) are misconfigured or missing, and advise mitigations such as avoiding sensitive data in URLs, enforcing HTTPS with HSTS, and issuing patches or configuration changes.

evidence_quotes.claim: Sensitive data transmitted in query parameters
evidence_quotes.quote: could transmit sensitive information in query parameters
could be intercepted using man in the middle techniques
IBM TXSeries for Multiplatforms 8.1, 8.2, 9.1, CICS TX Standard, 11.1, CICS TX Advanced 10.1, and 11.1
